<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# I need to check if the CORRECT SkyBlue_0 is in the 24-cycle for Pink_0.
# Current Pink_0 is at col 14-18, after 24 UP cycles (back to original).

# Cycle through all 24 states and check for match
cycle_pats = [p0_cur]
found = False
found_idx = -1

for i in range(23):
    action(['UP'])
    ascii_lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    pat = []
    for r in range(52, 57):
        row = []

        sb_str = '\n'.join(sb_pat)
        for ci, cp in enumerate(cycle_pats):
            if '\n'.join(cp) == sb_str:
                print(f"  SB{sb_i} found in P0 cycle at index {ci}")

# Now check all 5 Pink symbols vs all 5 SkyBlue symbols
# For each Pink symbol, cycle through 24 states and record which SkyBlue (if any) is in the cycle

print(f"SB0 found: {found} at index {found_idx}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
